name: The Wind Waker HD (native port)
game: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD
summary: Native Linux and Windows port of The Wind Waker HD. Portkeeper prepares your Cemu archive, decrypted ZIP or decrypted folder into data/game; the first start compiles the game code on your PC without asking for game files.

release_rules.notes: Asset names and the enclosing ZIP folder include the version, so each release needs a reviewed definition revision.

first_run.summary: The first start runs the release's setup once without questions: it uses the game files Portkeeper included in data/game, downloads the pinned compiler (internet needed) and builds the game code in about two minutes. Later starts launch the game directly.

inputs.label: Wind Waker HD Cemu archive or decrypted ZIP
inputs.notes: Choose a .wua archive or ZIP containing a decrypted code/content/meta folder. Alternatively choose the decrypted folder below. WUD/WUX need keys and are not yet prepared here.

inputs.label: Wind Waker HD decrypted game folder
inputs.notes: Select the folder containing code/, content/ and meta/. Title ID, version 0 and code/cking.rpx SHA-256 are checked before packaging.

source_checks.description: The USA game code hash the port is built for
Setup still builds non-interactively from an existing game folder

operations.description: Prepare and validate your version-0 Wii U game

linux.instructions: Extract the whole ZIP to a writable folder and run Launch.sh. The first start builds the game (internet needed, about two minutes); later starts open the game.

windows.instructions: Extract the whole ZIP to a writable folder and run Launch.cmd. The first start builds the game in a console window (internet needed, about two minutes); later starts open the game. If SmartScreen warns, choose More info, then Run anyway.

saves: portable.txt keeps saves (data/save), settings and shader caches (data/user) in the package folder.

linux: Python 3.8+ (setup downloads a pinned copy if missing)
Internet on first start for the pinned compiler
windows: Internet on first start for the pinned compiler

limitations: Prepares .wua, ZIP of a decrypted folder, or a decrypted code/content/meta folder. WUD/WUX require keys and are not yet supported by this recipe.
The first start still compiles the game code on the player's PC; Portkeeper cannot ship compiled game code.
The package contains your extracted game files (about 2-3 GB); keep it private.
Not yet launched on a real PC by Portkeeper.
history: Catalog revision 3: extract the player's Cemu archive with the release's own extractor and run the release's setup non-interactively on first start, so the game no longer asks for files.
Revision 4: validate decrypted folder and ZIP alternatives by metadata and RPX hash; source dumps remain unchanged.
